text.p: The Malaysian ringgit managed to recover on Thursday in Asia after being hit by offshore bidding for dollars, but another test of the upside for dollar/ringgit is on the cards, say technical analysts.

The dollar ran into resistance around the 2.5250 level in New York overnight, the high it reached during mid-May when the ringgit was suffering alongside the Thai baht, which itself was under speculative attack.

"Technically a break above 2.5250 would set up a move to 2.5330 but I'm sure Bank Negara are looking at the charts and they will likely be around anywhere above 2.5250," said one Singapore-based technical analyst.
Dealers in Kuala Lumpur have noted fear of central bank intervention was tending to cap the dollar's upside against the ringgit around the 2.5250 area.
The 2.5330 level represents the November 1996 peak and below that there will be lighter upside resistance around the 2.5300-10 area, which was the December 1996 high.

On the downside support is pegged at the highs of the congestion area from late May to the mid-June at around 2.5175 and this area also represents trendline support on a line drawn back to mid-May, technical analysts said.
"The trendline is not a particularly good one but if you smooth the sharp dollar/ringgit downturn on May 16 out, support comes in around 2.5175," one analyst said.

Fibonacci support also lies in the 2.5175 area although this is the lesser watched 78.6 percent retracement of the move down from 2.5330 in November to 2.4660 in January. The 61.8 percent retracement of the same move stands at 2.5075.
On the monthly chart a downtrend line drawn from the 2.6060 peak in August 1994 to the January 1996 high of 2.5680 extends to cut in around the 2.5320 area.
"If dollar/ringgit does take-off a break above that 2.5250 area it will run into heavy resistance around 2.5330 if you look at both the short-term and long-term charts," the analyst added.

At 0650 GMT dollar/ringgit was trading at 2.5208/28 against Wednesday's Asian close of 2.5232/42. The high in Asia today has been 2.5225 and the low 2.5199 as round-figure psychological support at 2.5200 held.
